purpose: Use measurement context and recurrence absent from three-second single-angle segments
data: Same 32 source records, channel choices, source labels and family assignments; one original 60-second segment centered on unchanged pilot phase candidate
features: Fixed 23 features in diagnosis_context.py: phase increments and impulse recurrence, reported frequency and phase-frequency agreement, voltage/current relative magnitude changes, voltage-current angle differences. No provider, ID, PMU count, status bit or file-format features.
training: 300-tree Random Forest seed 42; equal class, family and record weights; inner min_samples_leaf selection among 1,3,5
evaluation: Same 3 outer family-grouped folds; nested inner selection; unchanged 95% per-returned-class precision target; report all outcomes
stop_rule: One specified measurement-context candidate. Preserve results regardless of outcome. No changes driven by outer results.
evidence_role: Development comparison using previously examined sources; not independent final confirmation
limitations: Three timing families; unknown exact anomaly channel/interval; provider-class confounding remains; requires 60 seconds of complete 30 Hz voltage/current/frequency measurements; no normal-operation class, no localization or general sensor-fault claim
